subject: AsterMed — initial access handoff & role template
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa@astermed.com>, AsterMed IT <it@astermed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AsterMed — initial access handoff & role template

Hi Lisa / AsterMed IT team,

Thanks again for signing — excited to get your org live. Per our onboarding call, this thread will capture the minimal access items we need to finish tenant activation so your engineers can start calling the API and we can seed the workspace. Attached are two small files: a role template (astermed_role_template.yaml) and the API key guidance (api-key-instructions.pdf).

Summary of what we need from you to proceed:
- Confirm preferred cloud region (we suggested us-east-1 in the call).
- Confirm primary admin email (we'll seed one admin user and one service account).
- Confirm a short list of initial users to invite (admin, 2x devs, 1x security, 1x PM).
- Any constraints on key rotation / expiry windows (default 90 days unless you specify).

Proposed short plan (can be adjusted):
1) Redwood seeds org namespace and creates a dedicated project (Day 0).
2) We seed Admin user + one service account (Day 1) — keys delivered via secure portal.
3) We invite the remaining users (Day 1–2) and hand over role mapping.
4) Connor will run a smoke test (simple generate + embedding) and confirm performance.

Questions for you:
- Are there compliance rules (e.g., enforced KMS, HSM) we should enable now?
- Do you want API keys tied to service accounts or to short-lived tokens via your SSO?

Next steps / Owners:
- AsterMed IT: confirm region and admin email.
- Monica Patel (CS): coordinate invites and timing.
- Connor O'Brien (Implementation): will prepare seed plan and post the seed CSV here.

If you can reply with the region and primary admin by EOD tomorrow, we can schedule the seed for Thursday.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: astermed_role_template.yaml (role/permission mapping), api-key-instructions.pdf (how to handle keys securely)
From: Lisa Park <lisa@astermed.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: AsterMed IT <it@astermed.com>
Date: 2029-06-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AsterMed — initial access handoff & role template

Thanks Sean — quick answers:
- Region: us-east-1 (preferred).
- Primary admin: me (lisa.park@astermed.com).
- User list: I will send a short CSV with names/emails by EOD (we have 5 initial users).
- Compliance: we require keys be wrapped by our KMS for any production workloads. For staging it's okay to use Redwood-managed KMS initially.
- Key expiry: 180 days for service accounts is fine for now.

Also: can you confirm whether the first seeded service account will have embed-only permissions or full generate+embed? We'll probably want separate service accounts for embed pipelines.

Appreciate the clear plan — we want to get devs access early next week if possible.

Lisa Park
Head of Infra & Integrations
AsterMed
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa@astermed.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-01T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AsterMed — initial access handoff & role template

Thanks Lisa — good call on KMS. I'll make the staging/prod distinction explicit in the seed plan. Connor / Dylan — I've drafted the seed_plan.csv (attached) that maps:
- namespace (astermed-prod / astermed-staging)
- project slug
- admin account
- service accounts + desired scopes (embed-only, generate, rerank)
- initial user invite emails + role assignment

Connor: can you review the attached CSV and confirm you'll run the seed on Thu 2029-06-06? Connor, please also:
- Create a prod service account (embed-only) and a prod service account (generate+embed) as separate entities.
- Seed the admin user (Lisa) and invite the 5 listed devs — set SSO disabled for now so we can confirm keys.
- Upload generated keys to our secure transfer link and post a HubSpot note with the key delivery ID.

Dylan: once Connor seeds, please run the smoke test (generate + embed) and post timings + any QoS anomalies. If anything is degraded, we'll plan a quick rollback to the compatible model variant.

AsterMed: after seed and smoke test, we'll run a short onboarding walkthrough (30m) to confirm your devs can call endpoints and rotate keys.

I'll own coordination and timeline. Proposed dates: seed Thu 2029-06-06, smoke test Fri 2029-06-07, walkthrough Mon 2029-06-10.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: seed_plan.csv (columns: namespace,project,account_type,scopes,email,role,notes)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa@astermed.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-04T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AsterMed — initial access handoff & role template

Thanks — confirming I will run the seed on Thu 2029-06-06 as proposed. Quick notes:

- I reviewed the role YAML and split embed vs generate scopes as requested.
- For KMS: I'll mark the prod service accounts as requiring customer KMS; I'll need the KMS key ARN from AsterMed (please share in the secure channel).
- Keys: I'll generate short-lived keys (180d) for prod service accounts per Lisa's ask, and 30d for staging. Keys will be uploaded to our secure delivery link and logged in HubSpot (will post the delivery ID here).

On Thu I will post a short runbook in this thread with the exact API calls I ran and the verification commands so your ops team can validate.

On Thu morning I'll be offline 08:00–09:00 for a maintenance window, otherwise available.

-Connor
